claims.statement: The first-party demo uses two independently initialized file-backed content-addressed Hub stores, embeds the exact public KFD Agent Hub profile facts into three standalone platform binaries, and binds those binaries to one Buildchain Release Passport.

evidence.description: First-party behavioral tests for independent Hub state, delivery, conflict visibility, and export/import drift rejection.
Pinned public KFD Agent Hub declaration and exact tested capability scope.
Node SEA build and smoke-verification entrypoint used independently on Linux, macOS, and Windows runners.
Buildchain-owned publication authority, KFD witness collection, GitHub Release, and Release Passport route.

auditBoundary.scope: First-party agent-hub-demo source, Linux x64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64 standalone binaries, generated release evidence, and the exact KFD Agent Hub 20-vector suite pinned by the public dependency lock.
exclusions: Operating systems and architectures outside the three declared release targets

residualRisk.reason: Passing evidence does not establish general interoperability or certification beyond the declared first-party clean-room boundary.
